name: meld
description: Local-first collaborative whiteboard — umbrella package delegating to server/ (Hono on Node 22) and web/ (Next.js 15). CRDT layer is Yjs 13.x + y-websocket protocol; persistence is hybrid ops-log + debounced snapshots via a Hocuspocus Storage adapter against Postgres. See DECISIONS.md ADR-001 / ADR-002 / ADR-003.

scripts.build: pnpm -F meld-server build && pnpm -F meld-web build
scripts.lint: pnpm -F meld-server lint && pnpm -F meld-web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F meld-server typecheck && pnpm -F meld-web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -F meld-server test && pnpm -F meld-web test
